description: Colección Cartografía temática (1997-1999): Red ferroviaria RENFE en la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by visor.gva.es. HISTORICAL CARTOGRAPHY TERRITORIAL AFFECTIONS. RENFE railway network for the Valencian Community (year 1998) from the former COPUT. For more information on the methodology used consult the full text of the series at /Territorial Planning and Green Infrastructure /Documentation Center /Publications /Complete Texts Spatial Planning and Planning (pdf) /COLLECTIONS.- Thematic Mapping. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Collection Thematic cartography (1997-1999): RENFE railway network in the Valencian Community" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ferrocarriles, Comunitat Valenciana. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
